session_summary: Follow-up Family Liaison session focused on reviewing a pending task regarding guardian contact preferences, distinguishing between in-session rehearsal and external support delivery. The student reported that the main barrier (communication uncertainty) persists on some days but noted that early knowledge of plans helps. An in-session activity rehearsing an explanation of school needs was completed, though its effectiveness outside this room remains unverified.
primary_concern: Late or hard-to-understand notices affecting school attendance/participation; uncertainty about contact formats and availability of alternative methods.

tracked_details.detail: Review of agreed task: Ask guardian which contact time works best.
In-session activity: Rehearsed a short explanation of the student's school need.
Uncertainty regarding alternative contact formats (e.g., voicemail vs. phone log).
Verification of whether the student can repeat the rehearsed step alone.

next_steps: Student to attempt the rehearsed step alone and record what happens.
Check school office availability for alternative contact formats.
Verify if early knowledge of plans reduces difficulty on specific days.
uncertainties: Availability of the school office for follow-up.
Actual receipt of any external support services (none confirmed).
Effectiveness of the rehearsed explanation outside this session.
Exact dates and status of service availability.
conclusion: This follow-up session established a supportive environment where the student felt heard but did not receive external service delivery. The main barrier (communication uncertainty) remains unresolved as no alternative contact format was confirmed or received. An agreed action (asking guardian about timing) is reported as unclear/pending. Evidence supports that the session itself was helpful in clarifying steps and rehearsing a specific activity, but it does not establish improvement in the school barrier or attendance.
